tasks.title: Supply complete Trader market inputs on time
deliverables: Trader context with the latest completed close and a short recent completed-candle series, with candle identities and availability times

A synthetic slow-trend-pullback setup like BTC 2026-10-10 01:56Z reaches the Trader; no future or still-forming candle enters context

tasks.title: Unblock USD exposure checks, show refusals and clean mandate defaults
deliverables: USD-native exposure authorization independent of the EUR reporting FX date; EUR reports keep their provisional-valuation label

acceptance: Weekend and weekday pre-publication buys within the envelope are authorized while EUR reporting shows the stale-rate label
After a refused buy the next Trader turn still runs; owner and Leader pauses still persist
Regression tests reproduce each D114 cause and fail on the pre-fix code

tasks.title: Collect 1-, 5-, 15- and 60-minute Kraken candles for many pairs
deliverables: Additive candle store keyed by pair, interval and open time with receipt-time availability, source identity and immutable revisions

tasks.title: Import the Kraken OHLCVT archive and fill gaps from public Trades

Source precedence and overlap reconciliation between archive, Trades-built and collected candles; differences are reported, not silently merged
acceptance: A synthetic end-to-end import yields at least three months of 15-minute or finer history for the candidate universe
Re-importing the same archive is idempotent; a changed archive creates new revisions
Coverage report names missing pairs and states that delisted pairs are absent, so coin-selection history is optimistic

tasks.title: Compute a TA-Lib indicator menu with cross-checked tests
deliverables: Locked TA-Lib dependency (wheel with bundled C library, Python 3.12 Linux) and a menu contract: names, parameter bounds, warm-up and inputs
Engine code only selects completed candles, supplies warm-up history, reports missing candles per indicator and compares outputs with alarm levels; the Trader receives numbers, not chart images
Existing D89 hourly fields re-expressed through library functions or retired, so no indicator formula remains in-house

Documented seeding differences from TradingView are recorded, not patched with in-house formulas
Indicator values may be floats; prices, quantities, fees and balances remain Decimal (property test)

tasks.title: Watch headlines with Jev in shadow mode and log would-be news alarms
deliverables: Jev decision adapter for TypeSafe's POST /v1/systemone behind a small provider-neutral decision contract (state plus typed noul, choice and score questions in; probabilities out); plain HTTPS, no SDK in domain code; pinned jev-1.13.0, with the answering model recorded on every call

Dated price card from TypeSafe's official models page (USD0.042 per million input tokens, output free, read 2026-10-15); reservation and receipt for every call, retry and failure; a call without reported usage stays unresolved, never free

Headline collector polling owner-approved public feeds (recommended: every 5 minutes); each headline (title, link, publisher, publication time, receipt time) stored as a dated snapshot source before Jev sees it; repeats detected by link

Fixed question set per headline: which watched coin it concerns (paper coin list and held coins; the day's focus coins once T37 exists; Kraken itself; none), the event type (hack or exploit, delisting, listing, exchange outage or maintenance, regulatory action, other) and whether a holder of that coin would want to know within the hour; answers and the would-wake verdict are saved with the headline
Shadow mode only: no wake-ups, orders, budgets, settings or tools; a CLI report lists headlines, Jev answers, would-wake verdicts, latency and daily Jev spend
Key read only from the owner's private file, never in Git, logs or model context; Jev calls stay off until the owner installs a key and switches testing on (D137)
acceptance: Scripted fixtures cover success, HTTP 400, 401, 422, 429 and 529, timeout, missing usage, an unexpected model in the reply and malformed answers; default tests need no key
Headline text is data: a headline containing instructions changes no setting, wake-up, order or tool, and Jev answers cannot reach execution, budgets or owner policy
Answers are stored as received and never recomputed; repeated identical calls may differ and are kept as they came
The would-wake rule is an alarm setting, not a Trader confidence gate, and can only add wake-ups (D116)
Credentialed smoke is opt-in and reported separately; a mock is not a paid-provider test

tasks.title: Turn Jev news alarms into real wake-ups
deliverables: A news alarm wakes the Leader through the T35 wake dispatcher with the headline, its source and Jev's answers; a headline about a coin the paper account holds also wakes the Trader (recommended default, D137)
Wake reason 'news alarm' with the headline and source in HQ's wake log (T39)
Owner switch between shadow and live wake-ups, recorded as an owner policy revision; shadow logging continues either way
acceptance: A news alarm only adds wake-ups; it never delays, merges away or blocks another wake-up (D116)
The Leader and Trader read the headline as data; it cannot make either place, approve or block a trade
A scripted day with a planted delisting headline wakes the Leader, and the Trader when the coin is held; an unrelated headline wakes nobody
Going live is decided from T44 shadow evidence and HQ wake counts, not from fixtures

tasks.title: Share conservative limit-fill and protective-exit simulation with dated cost profiles
deliverables: One fill module used by the paper broker and the practice range: resting limits fill only when price trades through, never on a touch; same-bar ambiguity resolves against the strategy
Protective exits (stop-loss and take-profit on one position, one cancels the other) simulated as triggered taker exits with slippage
Dated cost profiles as data records: Kraken spot current tier, Kraken after the $10k 30-day volume discount, OKX Europe spot; Decimal fees and minimums
acceptance: Paper broker passes shared broker conformance on the new module; existing T05 fill guarantees hold
Golden cases: touch-only bar does not fill; a gap through a stop fills at the worse open; a bar hitting both exits takes the stop
Profiles carry source URLs and dates; changing a profile never rewrites earlier results

tasks.title: Replay strategies in the practice range and report results
deliverables: Replay of a registered strategy version (allowlisted data artifact using menu indicators) on at least three months of 15-minute or finer history under each cost profile
Tune-on-earlier and confirm-on-untouched-later windows recorded with dates; the later window cannot be reused for tuning
Report: trades, win rate, average win and loss, after-fee result versus cash and holding BTC, worst drawdown and losing streak, from a metrics module the scorecard reuses
OKX public candles for smaller coins under the OKX profile, because their spreads differ from Kraken
acceptance: Deterministic report on a synthetic fixture with hand-checked Decimal results; default tests use recorded Kraken and OKX public fixtures and make no network calls
Reports persist strategy version, data sources, cost profile and windows; reruns reproduce them
Reports are labelled evidence for Trader discretion, not a pass mark, profitability claim or live authorization

tasks.title: Enforce the owner money-risk envelope and paper symbol scope

Owner policy revision that widens the paper symbol scope to scanner-eligible pairs (rule or list), audited and revision-checked

A synthetic day that crosses the loss limit cancels resting entries, refuses new ones and keeps protective exits; buying resumes at the next day start
Agents cannot edit these fields and the Leader cannot raise them; D127 products (futures, perpetuals, short sales, margin, lending or earn) are refused and any interest posting is flagged

tasks.title: Watch prices with persisted one-shot alarms
deliverables: Alarm contract for price levels and menu-indicator thresholds on completed candles or live quotes, owned by a department with an optional day-plan reference
Software watcher on every public price update and completed candle; an alarm fires once and stays spent until re-armed

acceptance: Deterministic-clock tests: no double fire across restarts, no fire from a still-forming candle, batched delivery
Watching costs no model tokens; feed loss is reported, never treated as a quiet market
No limit on alarm count or firing frequency beyond the one-shot rule (D116)

tasks.title: Install Trader day plans with resting entries and protective exits

tasks.title: Wake departments on events and their own chosen check-ins

acceptance: No cap on wakes or activity: coalescing may batch wakes but never drops them, and per-root delegation bounds apply within a wake, never to the number of wakes; the subscription-allowance floor still pauses new AI while management continues
Restart neither loses nor repeats a wake; obsolete wakes never become trades
A scripted day with scripted Research produces scanner, focus, plan, alarm wake, fill wake, exit wake and day-end review
